event_management.title: Event Management
event_management.desc: Create and manage your nights in a few clicks. Keep event details and table availability up to date, and monitor bookings in real time for a successful night.

entry_scanner.title: Entry Scanner
entry_scanner.desc: Speed up access to your club. Use the integrated QR scanner to validate customers' digital tickets at the entrance for smooth and secure crowd control.

lists_tables.title: Lists & Tables
lists_tables.desc: Organize your space. Manage waiting list requests and table bookings (VIP and main floor) by approving requests to enable secure payments on the platform.

payments.title: Payments
payments.desc: Full transparency on your earnings. Confirmed payments are paid out in a monthly batch. The commission covers transaction handling and platform technical support.

room_management.title: Room Management
room_management.desc: Accept or reject bookings in real time from the 'Room Management' section. Track customer arrivals for excellent service.

qr_scanner.title: QR Scanner
qr_scanner.desc: Quickly validate customer arrivals. Use the built-in scanner to verify digital bookings when seating guests.

booking_schedule.title: Booking Schedule
booking_schedule.desc: Stay in control. In 'Incoming' you'll find confirmed bookings ready for service. Use 'Archive' to view the full history of completed, cancelled, or rejected bookings.

commissions_payments.title: Commissions & Payments
commissions_payments.desc: Automatic and transparent calculation. Commissions (€2.50 per cover) are deducted only for completed bookings, with monthly payout to your account.

booking_schedule.title: Booking Schedule
booking_schedule.desc: Monitor your property's activity. In 'Incoming' you’ll find all check-ins from today onward, including bookings cancelled during the day. 'Archive' includes only stays with a check-in before today. Each booking has a unique code (COD) for quick identification.

reception_scanner.title: Reception Scanner
reception_scanner.desc: Streamline check-in with the built-in scanner. Scan guests’ identity documents to automatically capture required data, reducing wait times and manual errors.

your_rooms.title: Your Rooms
your_rooms.desc: Keep availability up to date. You can adjust prices for special periods, update room descriptions, and manage calendars to avoid overlaps.

payments_compensation.title: Payments & Payouts
payments_compensation.desc: Transparency matters. Net payout is settled monthly for all completed stays. The service fee covers transaction handling and platform insurance.

request_management.title: Request Management
request_management.desc: Check the 'Pending' section to accept new storage requests. Always verify the number and size of items at drop-off.

storage_scanner.title: Storage Scanner
storage_scanner.desc: Use the scanner to validate both drop-off and pickup.

security_custody.title: Security & Custody
security_custody.desc: Keep items in secure areas not accessible to the public. We recommend using security seals to ensure service integrity.

rates_hours.title: Rates & Hours
rates_hours.desc: Manage prices by size (Small, Medium, Large) and opening hours directly from the 'Edit Storage' section.

payments.title: Payments
payments.desc: Full transparency on your reimbursements. Accumulated earnings are paid out monthly to your bank account, minus the platform service fee.

request_management.title: Request Management
request_management.desc: New bookings appear in 'Ride Requests'. You can accept, adjust the price (extras or changes), or reject if you can’t cover the service.

current_ride.title: Ride in Progress
current_ride.desc: Confirmed rides appear in 'Current ride'. Here you see the route map and can mark the ride as completed at the end of the transfer.

ride_scanner.title: Ride Scanner
ride_scanner.desc: Use the Scanner to validate the customer's voucher via QR code when welcoming them on board.

rates_fleet.title: Rates & Fleet
rates_fleet.desc: In 'Your Service' you can update available vehicles, per-km or zone rates, and night/holiday surcharges.

payments.title: Payments
payments.desc: Receive payments directly to your account.

rules.title: Rules
rules.desc: Set house rules and cancellation terms.
